definition.prompt: Create one original full-body cartoon wizard as an animation reference. Friendly adult wizard with a simple round face, two clearly visible open eyes, a dark blue pointed hat with a gold star, matching blue robe, brown boots, and one wooden staff held in the right hand, with a small amber crystal at its tip. Clean confident ink outlines and flat cel colors. Front three-quarter standing pose, both feet and the entire staff visible. Plain pure white background and generous margins around the figure and staff. No text, no logo, no animation grid.

review.notes: Clean full-body blue wizard, hat and open eyes clear, complete staff and boots inside white frame; suitable consistent animation anchor.
